style: Clean 2D illustrated style with confident inked linework and flat cel shading, muted natural palette on a warm cream background, soft ambient occlusion, no photorealism, no 3D render, no anime.
character: Brian, a 28-year-old delivery driver, 6 feet tall, average build. Dark blond hair pulled into a small top knot, short trimmed beard, friendly open expression. Wears an oversized off-white t-shirt with a grayscale photographic graphic on the chest, khaki cargo joggers with a thigh pocket and elasticated cuffs, and black low-top sneakers with gum soles.
negative: photorealistic, 3D render, anime, distorted hands, extra fingers, warped face, text, lettering, signage, watermark, logo, gibberish writing, oversaturated colors

shots.caption: At the warehouse, show dispatch the code on your phone.
shots.narration: When you get to the warehouse, find dispatch and show them the code on your phone.
shots.scene: Wide shot inside a bright grocery distribution warehouse. Brian stands at a dispatch counter facing a dispatcher in a dark green polo and cap. Brian holds up his phone toward the dispatcher with his right hand, screen facing away from camera. Stacked insulated delivery bags and a metal rack are visible behind the counter. Warm daylight from high windows.
shots.motion: Brian raises his phone slightly and the dispatcher leans in to look at the screen, then nods. Subtle natural body movement, camera locked off, no camera push.

shots.caption: Give them your route number.
shots.narration: Then give them your route number.
shots.scene: Medium shot inside the same warehouse. Brian stands at the dispatch counter, relaxed, speaking to the dispatcher who writes on a clipboard. The metal rack of insulated bags sits behind them. Same warm daylight and cream-toned palette.
shots.motion: Brian speaks and gestures once with an open hand; the dispatcher writes on the clipboard. Gentle idle motion, camera locked off.
